contract_basis.rule: Six kinds are distinguished, with separate appendix sections. Explicit purity acceptance requirement at line 246 concerns the default MAIN_TEXT collection. This text does not explicitly promise content-only APPENDIX/VARIANT or physical-page-based ownership of editorial metadata.

Watermark fonts and white invisible text are EDITORIAL first; then appendix scope returns APPENDIX and alternate-chapter scope returns VARIANT before font/size-derived EDITORIAL. Thus visible running headers/page numbers inside those scopes are deliberately classified by scope in the current implementation. This code establishes the mechanism, not literary acceptance or an unqualified documented semantic exception.

Chapter scopes start at the standalone heading's character offset and stop at the next such offset; slices retain mixed page metadata. Ownership describes extraction slices, not every item on the physical page.

Builder consumes fixed chapter/appendix scopes, classifies each exact raw run and merges adjacent same-kind chunks across pages. Locator transforms remain empty. Chapter reading views concatenate only MAIN_TEXT.
Formal corpus review requires an INDEPENDENT_HUMAN and separate layer/locator/context checks. This verification is a model research artifact, not such a review.
